scores.evidence: The proposal offers an ad on s21 directly beside the account sign-up button ('Add Simula rewarded offer button alongside the sign-up button on the Favorite messages sheet.'). An ad cannot stand in for creating an account on a sign-up wall, and patch uses delta 1 for entitlement resource r2 (Account Access). Per rules 7 and 8, treating entitlements as currency and substituting account creation with an ad caps value-moment-fit at 1.

The proposal places a rewarded ad button directly on the account creation wall ('Add Simula rewarded offer button alongside the sign-up button'). This bypasses the natural account creation funnel and corrupts entitlement logic by granting account access via ad views.

The offer is restricted to guests and time-boxed ('Access is time-boxed to 72 hours and restricted to guests'). However, offering it directly on the free signup sheet risks cannibalizing free account creation.
Code derived numbers: 'Cost to serve per view: $0.0000 (none x 0). One completed US view earns $0.0090–$0.0150'. Zero COGS and positive ad margin per view.
Digest indicates 'm5 [wall] on s21 (Favorite messages), reach=frequent'. Favorite message sheet is frequently visited when guest users interact with message saving.
Proposal uses SIM-RWD unit but defines patch effect as 'resource: r2, delta: 1'. Granting Account Access as a +1 currency increment is structurally invalid in the app backend economy.
Proposal cites s21, r2, and Luzia. However, per rule 7, treating entitlement r2 (Account Access) as a consumable currency (+1 delta) forfeits specificity credit for that noun.
Includes primary KPI ('Rewarded ad ARPDAU'), signup conversion guardrail ('Free account signup conversion rate'), and a '5% user-level holdout for 28 days'.

requiredChanges: Do not offer rewarded ads directly on the sign-up wall as an alternative to creating an account; account creation must remain the primary action on the wall.
Reframe the trigger to occur only after the user declines or dismisses the account signup wall (e.g. post-decline sampling).
Fix the reward state model so it grants a temporary feature unlock rather than attempting to increment entitlement r2 ('Account Access') as a +1 currency delta.
parsed.topConcern: The proposal attempts to place a rewarded ad option directly on the free account sign-up wall as an alternative to creating an account, and treats the 'Account Access' entitlement as a consumable currency (+1 delta). An ad must never stand in for account creation, and entitlements cannot be incremented like currency.
